0:npc:-1: Well, what can I do for you, my young friend?
0:choice:0: Howdy. So you're the extremely famous Greenhorn-Jim?
0:choice:1: Howdy. Greenhorn-Jim, how are you doing, sir?
0:choice:2: Sir, that's quite a special rifle you've got there...
1:npc:-1: Well, I suppose I'm known across the entire country by that name.
1:choice:0: More like the entire world, sir!
1:choice:1: Well, maybe not the ENTIRE country, right?
2:npc:-1: Now please do not exaggerate. I'm just an ordinary man.
2:choice:0: But you've surely been through so many incredible and noble adventures, sir!
2:choice:1: Perhaps you're right. You look fairly ordinary.
3:npc:-1: Well now, I'm simply trying to do the right thing, that's all.
3:choice:1: And you manage to achieve that over and over again in such a wonderful way.
4:npc:-1: Are you getting cheeky with me now, young fella?
4:choice:0: No, I've actually been pretty cheeky the whole time!
4:choice:1: I would never allow myself to do that, sir!
5:npc:-1: You'd better apologize to me this instant, or else...
5:choice:1: Or else you're gonna shoot me dead on the spot?
5:choice:2: Or else you're gonna breathe fire and sulfur?
6:npc:-1: Alright, that settles it, as far as I'm concerned. I need to calm down now.
7:npc:-1: Are you going to apologize, or not?
9:npc:-1: I have to admit, I possess certain abilities that most of my fellow humans probably do not have.
9:choice:0: For instance, the ability to be a humble brag.
10:npc:-1: You seem to be quite a fan of mine, aren't you?
10:choice:0: I'm just a humble, yet captivated admirer of your deeds!
10:choice:1: Nah, I believe noble Western heroes are a thing of the past.
11:npc:-1: Is it just my imagination, or are you flattering me quite heavily?
11:choice:0: Ha! I'll flatter just about anyone if they have something I'm after!
11:choice:1: Your ability to read people is truly unsurpassed, sir!
12:npc:-1: You'd better practice that a bit more. It was way too blunt, my friend!
13:npc:-1: Splendid, thanks for asking, young man!
13:choice:0: You seem to be in high spirits, sir.
13:choice:2: Then, I suppose you're gonna let me take a look at your extraordinary rifle?
14:npc:-1: Yeah, why not? I'm doing good, everything's going great...
14:choice:0: Then perhaps you're also in a downright generous mood?
14:choice:1: Well, as long as you're doing good, who cares about anyone else, right?!
15:npc:-1: That's somehow true. Today I could give it all away and still be happy.
15:choice:0: You look pretty broke. I doubt there's much left for you to give away.
15:choice:1: Why not, indeed? What's the meaning of personal property, anyway?
16:npc:-1: Exactly. In the wilderness, for example, you often have to be able to survive completely without possessions.
16:choice:0: I bet you can do that perfectly, sir.
16:choice:1: As a matter of fact, you do look as if you're crawling around in the wilderness all the time.
17:npc:-1: Yes, I don't need much to survive out there.
17:choice:0: So why not hand your rifle over to me, sir? I could really use it.
17:choice:1: Bragging is a talent in itself, wouldn't you say?
18:npc:-1: My rifle? The Boomstick?! I need my rifle!
18:choice:0: Whine, whine, whine. Just like a little kid!
18:choice:1: Not really. I bet you could manage even without the rifle.
19:npc:-1: And I bet you can manage just as well without it. The rifle stays with me!
20:npc:-1: What do you mean by that?
20:choice:0: You look pretty worn out, sir.
20:choice:1: Well, given what happened to your blood brother the Broken Eagle...
21:npc:-1: The Broken Eagle? What happened to the Broken Eagle?
21:choice:0: Well, fortunately he wasn't injured very badly when he fell off his horse.
21:choice:1: You're acting just like a mother hen with her chicks!
22:npc:-1: Why did he fall off his horse?
22:choice:0: Because, sadly enough, he rides just as badly as you do, sir!
22:choice:1: Well, the horse naturally bucked when the bullet grazed it.
23:choice:0: A bullet point, of course, you dummy!
23:choice:1: Easy now, the soldier was aiming for the Broken Eagle in the first place!
24:npc:-1: A soldier shot at the Broken Eagle? But why???
24:choice:0: Because, sadly, he couldn't find YOU.
24:choice:1: Soldiers tend to fire at Indians who've dug up the hatchet.
25:npc:-1: The Broken Eagle dug up the hatchet? Why on earth??!!
25:choice:0: Presumably because he had buried it earlier, Sherlock Holmes!
25:choice:1: He was probably trying to set the whole Apache tribe on you, sir.
26:choice:0: Well, because you're always making jokes about Native Americans being primitive.
26:choice:1: You just happen to look like an ideal victim, sir.
27:npc:-1: WHO SAYS THAT, FOR GOD'S SAKE???!!!
27:choice:0: Oh come on, everyone in this country knows that, sir.
27:choice:1: Could it be that little voice inside your head?
28:npc:-1: THE BROKEN EAGLE FELL OFF HIS HORSE BECAUSE A SOLDIER SHOT AT HIS HORSE...
29:npc:-1: ... AFTER THR BROKEN EAGLE HAD DUG UP THE HATCHET TO HUNT ME DOWN...
30:npc:-1: ... SIMPLY BECAUSE I SUPPOSEDLY MAKE JOKES ABOUT INDIANS???!!!!
30:choice:0: Exactly, sir. Which is why I was so surprised you're still doing so well.
31:npc:-1: I need a drink now. Lilly, make it a triple, immediately!!
31:choice:0: (How is he going to handle that? He usually never drinks...)
32:npc:-1: My rifle - the Boomstick... I call it "The Big Blower"...
32:choice:0: You must be awfully proud of that rifle!
32:choice:1: That thing looks pretty filthy, if you ask me!
33:npc:-1: I am. It is extremely valuable.
33:choice:0: Sure... but why? What's so special about it?
33:choice:1: Extremely valuable? Well, I don't think so!
34:npc:-1: It's a special build. Multi-shot, extremely precise, with silver rivets on the stock...
34:choice:1: Does it have a rivet on the trigger, too?
35:npc:-1: The finest silver. A true marvel of gunsmithing craft!
35:choice:0: Pretty crudely made. Looks more like paste-work than a piece of fine gunsmithing!
35:choice:1: That actually doesn't look like real silver at all...
36:npc:-1: But it really is pure, solid silver, boy!
36:choice:0: I bet you wear that thing around your neck at parties, right?
36:choice:1: Real silver would surely have tarnished by now...
37:npc:-1: Oh, no! I polish those rivets several times a day.
37:choice:0: Still... those rivets look more like tin to me!
38:choice:0: Great. Otherwise that dud of a rifle would look like absolute trash!
38:choice:1: No... No, I just don't believe it!
39:npc:-1: I'll prove it to you... But I don't know how?
39:choice:0: No proof necessary. I know that you can't tell silver from tin!
39:choice:1: Give me one of those rivets. I can test it.
40:npc:-1: AHA! Nice try, but I know that trick already. You're not the first souvenir hunter I've run into, pal!
